name: Goat Birria, Sealed-Pot Braise
cooking_method: Sear, coat with chile adobo, seal and braise low, skim; dip tortillas in surface fat and griddle to order

portion.description: 2 tacos + a small cup of consommé
portion.construction: no cheese by default; bones and visible fibre keep it reading as goat, not beef

lines.prep: 100 g cooked meat from the batch + 90 ml consommé (by-product, allocated at zero)
2 tortillas, dipped in skimmed braise fat and griddled

steps: Prepare the braise batch (see sub-recipe): adobo, sear, seal, braise low until tender but fibrous; skim and strain.
Cool and store in shallow pans following the written cooling process (professional-set).
To order: reheat meat and consommé to 74 °C or above; dip tortillas in skimmed fat, griddle until lightly crisp; fill with meat, raw onion, cilantro, hari; serve with the consommé cup and lime.

critical_parameters.braise: time/temperature set by a chef and logged; no authoritative goat braise temperature found in the repository research
critical_parameters.reheat_C: 74 (165 °F) minimum for the consommé and meat
critical_parameters.cooling: 57 → 21 °C within 2 h, → 5 °C within 4 more hours (US Food Code orientation; professional sets the process)

plating: Two tacos on a plate, edges crisped by the dipped-and-griddled tortilla; consommé in a small clay or steel cup (katori-like) with a visible fat sheen and a few chile flecks; raw onion, cilantro and a lime wedge on the plate, hari in a small spoonful.
equipment: Braise kettle or oven (long braise; lead time)
Shallow pans and blast-chill or ice bath for cooling
Small clay or steel cups for consommé
food_safety: Largest food-safety risk in the Core 5: large-batch braise cooling, storage and reheating; a food-safety professional must write the process before any service.
Goat/chicken/vegetable stock only; no beef or pork products, no lard (D-54); no halal claim.
Skimmed fat solidifies; label and use within the written shelf life.
Hot consommé service: burn risk, correct cup, handle temperature.

day_before: Braise batch (about 12 portions), cool and portion
morning: Reheat portions, mise en place of garnishes
service: Dip and griddle tortillas, plate with consommé
workflow.capacity_note: long lead and yield/trim waste unknown; goat sourcing and supplier reliability unverified

consommé in a small cup with fat sheen and chile flecks
